signature.instructions:
Decompose a banker request into bounded information and action requirements.
Preserve original request intent. Generate subqueries as derived search/action plans.
Focus on banking reliability: answerability, risk, human review, tool selection.

fields.description: Original banker request, e.g., Prepare brief for Nordic Industrial A/S
Safe namespaced memory context, e.g., user prefers concise briefs
Available data sources: synthetic_crm, synthetic_credit, sec_filings, trading, etc.
Available tools: client_lookup, credit_snapshot, document_search, etc.
One of: pre_meeting_brief, credit_lookup, relationship_lookup, trading_lookup, false_premise, unanswerable, conflict_check
One of: answerable, requires_internal_data, requires_external_data, insufficient_evidence, incorrect_premise, conflict_detected, tool_unavailable, policy_blocked
List subset of: internal, research, analysis
List of required tool names from available_tools
Derived research subqueries for external retrieval, 2-4 focused questions
One of: low, medium, high, critical
True if conflict, missing authoritative data, false premise, or high risk
